name: Rival Ads
description: Tracks competitors’ ads on Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn from public ad libraries, and exposes monitors, ad movement and stored strategy analyses over a REST API and a remote MCP server.

skills.name: Competitor Monitors
skills.description: Creates, lists, updates and deletes monitors that each track one competitor on one of the Meta, Google, TikTok or LinkedIn ad channels.

skills.name: Ad Movement Feed
skills.description: Reads which ads a monitored competitor launched, kept running or stopped, via the Intelligence ad-movement endpoint.

skills.name: Strategic Analyses
skills.description: Lists the stored strategic analyses generated for a monitored competitor over a chosen week or month window.

skills.name: Monitor Sync Jobs
skills.description: Triggers a fresh ad-library sync for a monitor and polls the resulting job until it is completed or failed.

skills.name: Swipe File Library
skills.description: Saves, moves and removes ads in the shared swipe file and manages its folders.

skills.name: Client Projects
skills.description: Groups monitors into client, brand or market projects, and creates, renames or deletes them.

skills.name: Client Report Links
skills.description: Reads and updates the revocable client-facing report share link for a monitor.
